title_en: Promotion of the SNU Grand Quest Academy 2027 Junior Program
summary: This notice promotes the 2027 Junior Program of the SNU Grand Quest Academy. Only the title of the notice was available; it gives no eligibility rules, application method, deadlines or location. Please check the original notice or contact the department office for details.

dates.what: Year of the SNU Grand Quest Academy Junior Program being promoted

Title: Promotion of the 2027 Junior Program of the "SNU Grand Quest Academy" [「SNU 그랜드퀘스트 아카데미」 2027년 주니어 과정 홍보]

Note: The notice consisted only of this title; no body text was provided. Any attachment or image that may accompany the original notice was not read. Please refer to the original notice or contact the department office for further information.
